content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
I hope you are well.

- The relevant clause requires the contractor to perform any additional services requested during the term at no extra charge. This could lead to unlimited unpaid work. I propose that additional services be performed only after the parties execute a written change order that specifies the scope and the corresponding fees.
- The relevant clause allows the client to request unlimited revisions until fully satisfied, which may consume unlimited time and resources. I suggest limiting revisions to three rounds per deliverable, with any further changes handled through a written change order and additional fees.
- The relevant clause treats requests outside the defined scope as part of the services, potentially requiring work without extra compensation. I recommend that out‑of‑scope requests be addressed only via a written change order and be subject to additional fees.
- The revision allowance is currently stated as unlimited, which could increase workload indefinitely. I propose setting the allowance to up to three revision rounds, with any additional revisions billed at the agreed hourly rate.

Thank you for your consideration.
